arxiv-2406-12178.description: Abstract Repetitive action counting quantifies the frequency of specific actions performed by individuals. pmc-12666575.description: BackgroundThe difference between the jugular bulb venous and arterial carbon dioxide (CO2) tension, the cerebral pCO2 gap, is a marker of global tissue perfusion and can be affected by various mechanisms that underlie hypoxic-ischemic brain injury (HIBI). We hypothesized the CO2 gap and SjvO2 together could identify treatment responsive pathophysiology among those with abnormally elevated SjvO2.
